title: Ene, You Are a Leopard!
audience: Ethiopian families, young viewers, and friends watching on mobile or desktop
intent: Share an affectionate, humorous childhood memory where Ene hurries to bring Abush home for lunch and earns the playful nickname 'Ene, you are a leopard!'
style_block: Intimate documentary cinematography in warm natural daylight, authentic Ethiopian rural and home textures, 35mm film grain, 16:9 aspect ratio

character.description: Ene is an affectionate, quick-footed Ethiopian grandmother in a traditional shawl who protects Abush and laughs with the family; Ababa is a hardworking grandfather returning home around midday for lunch; Abush is a playful young grandson who loses track of time playing in the neighboring village and calls Ene 'leopard'.

music.caption: Warm Ethiopian krar, washint, and soft acoustic plucks shifting from light midday rhythm to brisk hurry, playful comedy, and warm family laughter

shots.reason: Establish the midday lunch setting and notice that Abush is missing from the yard
shots.image_prompt: Bright midday sunlight in a quiet Ethiopian rural courtyard, prepared lunch plates and traditional clay dish waiting near a shaded doorway while the yard is empty, warm documentary style, photorealistic
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle push-in across the quiet midday courtyard and waiting lunch

narration.text: የቀትር ሰዓት ደርሷል—ምሳ ተዘጋጅቷል፣ ግን የአባባና የእነ የልጅ ልጅ አቡሽ በአቅራቢያ የለም።
narration.english: Lunchtime has arrived—the meal is ready, but Ababa and Ene's grandson Abush is nowhere nearby.

shots.reason: Show Abush absorbed in play in the neighboring village past lunchtime
shots.image_prompt: A young Ethiopian boy named Abush playing energetically outdoors near a neighboring village path in bright daylight, joyful carefree energy, authentic documentary cinematography, photorealistic
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle tracking shot following the young boy playing happily outdoors

narration.text: አቡሽ ጨዋታ ይዞት ወደ ጎረቤት መንደር ሄዷል—ሰዓት መድረሱን እንኳን ረስቷል።
narration.english: Abush went to the neighboring village to play—he even forgot that lunchtime had arrived.

shots.reason: Introduce Ababa returning home from work tired and ready for lunch
shots.image_prompt: An older Ethiopian grandfather arriving home around midday in warm sunlight, walking into the courtyard with calm posture after work, authentic grounded mood, photorealistic
shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle push-in as the grandfather steps into the courtyard

narration.text: አባባ ከሥራ ተመለሰ፤ ቀኑን ደክሞ ስለዋለ፣ ቤቱ ሲረጋጋ ምሳውን ለመብላት ተቀመጠ።
narration.english: Ababa returned from work; after a tiring day, once the house settled, he sat down to eat lunch.

shots.reason: Capture the moment Ababa asks for Abush and Ene gives a reassuring white lie
shots.image_prompt: Inside a warm Ethiopian home at lunchtime, an older grandfather looking around asking a question while an older grandmother keeps a calm, composed expression so he will not get upset, photorealistic
shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle shot-reverse-shot drift between grandfather and grandmother

narration.text: አባባ 'አቡሽ የት አለ?' ሲል ጠየቀ፤ እነ አባባ እንዳይበሳጭ 'እዚሁ አካባቢ ነው' አለች።
narration.english: Ababa asked, 'Where is Abush?' So Ababa wouldn't get upset, Ene said, 'He is right around here.'

shots.reason: Show Ene hurrying briskly to the next village to fetch Abush quietly
shots.image_prompt: An older Ethiopian grandmother wearing a traditional shawl hurrying briskly along a sunlit dirt path toward a neighboring village, determined and loving hurry, photorealistic
shots.motion_prompt: Smooth forward tracking movement following the grandmother walking briskly down the path

narration.text: በውስጧ ግን ቸኮለች—አባባ ሳያውቅ አቡሽን ለማምጣት ወደ ሌላኛው መንደር ፈጠነች።
narration.english: Inside, however, she hurried—she rushed to the other village to bring Abush before Ababa noticed.

shots.reason: Show Ene lifting Abush onto her back and urging him to hurry home
shots.image_prompt: An older Ethiopian grandmother lifting a young boy onto her back in warm afternoon light near a village path, wrapping her shawl securely so they can hurry home together, affectionate candid moment, photorealistic
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle slow camera arc framing grandmother and boy as she carries him on her back

narration.text: አቡሽን ስታገኘው ጀርባዋ ላይ አዘለችውና 'ለአባባ እዚሁ ነህ ብያለሁ፣ በፍጥነት እንሂድ' አለችው።
narration.english: When she found Abush, she put him on her back and said, 'I told Ababa you're right here—let's go quickly.'

shots.reason: Deliver the signature funny line and laugh as Abush rides on Ene's back
shots.image_prompt: A young boy riding on his grandmother's back in warm afternoon sunlight, laughing with bright eyes and playful expression as they move along the path, joyful authentic moment, photorealistic
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle push-in on the laughing boy riding on his grandmother's back

narration.text: ጀርባዋ ላይ እንደተቀመጠ፣ አቡሽ ሳቀና 'እነ ነብር ነሽ!' ብሎ በፈገግታ ተናገረ።
narration.english: Once seated on her back, Abush laughed and smilingly said, 'Ene, you are a leopard!'

shots.reason: Show Ene and Abush heading back with fond warmth as the rush becomes a shared memory
shots.image_prompt: Grandmother and young grandson heading back along the sunlit path in warm late-afternoon light, a warm fond smile on her face as the rush turns into a shared joke, photorealistic
shots.motion_prompt: Smooth tracking shot as they head back in warm golden light

narration.text: የእነ ፈጣን ሩጫና የአቡሽ ቀልድ፣ በቤተሰቡ ውስጥ የማይረሳ ትዝታ ሆኖ ተቀረጸ።
narration.english: Ene's fast dash and Abush's joke became an unforgettable memory inside the family.

shots.reason: Show Ene retelling the story to the family while everyone laughs together
shots.image_prompt: A warm family gathering in soft evening light inside an Ethiopian home, an older grandmother animatedly telling a story with a big smile while family members laugh together, joyful togetherness, photorealistic
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle pan across the smiling, laughing family gathered together

narration.text: ከዚያ በኋላ እነ ይህን ታሪክ ለቤተሰቡ ስታወራ፣ ሁሉም ሳቅ እየተባባሉ ደጋግመው ይስቃሉ።
narration.english: After that, whenever Ene tells this story to the family, everyone shares laughs and laughs again.

shots.reason: Close on the title punchline 'እነ ነብር ነሽ!' in calm evening light
